services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: At Pacific Angler we operate a prestigious fleet of Grady White salmon fishing boats with the best engines and salmon fishing gear money can buy. From 1-2 anglers up to multi boat corporate events, we have the right boats for your Vancouver salmon fishing adventure. Our fleet consists of 23, 25, 27, and two 28 foot Grady Whites. The legendary smooth ride of a Grady White with the premium Yamaha power will get you to the fishing grounds quickly and comfortably. The 4-stroke motors are extremely quiet and have no fumes so you can fish in complete tranquility and comfort. blurb: Pacific Angler Fishing Charters offers guided salmon fishing trips in Vancouver waters year-round. They provide 5, 8, and 10 hour charters as well as overnight trips to Bowen Island and Gulf Islands. Their fleet includes 25, 27, and 28 foot Grady White boats suitable for 1-2 anglers up to multi-boat corporate events.
